hooks.name: Regenerar CODE-MAP al crear un archivo de código
hooks.description: When a .py/.sh file is created, regenerate docs/CODE-MAP.md so the code map stays current. Fails silently if the generator or repo is absent (e.g. cloud sandbox).

action.command: cd "${NAS_DOTFILES:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -f agent/tools/project_index.py ] || exit 0; NAS_DOTFILES="$(pwd)" python3 agent/tools/project_index.py --code-map >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0

hooks.name: Regenerar CODE-MAP al borrar un archivo de código
hooks.description: When a .py/.sh file is deleted, regenerate docs/CODE-MAP.md so it no longer lists the removed file. Fails silently if the generator or repo is absent.

action.command: cd "${NAS_DOTFILES:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -f agent/tools/project_index.py ] || exit 0; NAS_DOTFILES="$(pwd)" python3 agent/tools/project_index.py --code-map >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
